tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Network status
tools.description: Is the network live: block height, blocks per second, validators agreeing, and whether trading and deposits are open. Ask: "Is Vordium up right now?"

tools.name: get_network
tools.title: Network identity
tools.description: Which Vordium network this server reads, checked against the network itself, and the facts it vouches for (chain id, genesis, finalized block, agent trading on or off), and whether it matches the chain id and genesis this release is pinned to (nothing is signed otherwise). Ask: "Which network am I connected to?"

tools.name: get_markets
tools.title: Markets
tools.description: Every market the network lists, with its state, leverage, fees and trading rules (tick, lot, minimum size). Ask: "Which markets can I trade?"

tools.name: get_fees
tools.title: Fees and margins
tools.description: Maker and taker fees, maximum leverage, initial and maintenance margin, and the liquidation terms as the network publishes them (the fee, or none), for every market or one. Ask: "What does it cost to trade BTC with 10x?"

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

tools.name: get_oracle
tools.title: Prices
tools.description: Oracle and mark prices, for every market or one. Ask: "What is the ETH price?"

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

tools.name: get_orderbook
tools.title: Order book
tools.description: Resting bids and asks for one market, best first, with the spread. Ask: "How deep is the BTC book?"

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

tools.name: get_candles
tools.title: Candles
tools.description: Price candles (open, high, low, close, volume) for one market. Ask: "How did ETH move over the last day?"

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

price.description: mark price (default) or last traded price

tools.name: get_trades
tools.title: Recent trades
tools.description: The latest trades in one market: time, side, price, size and value. Ask: "Show the last 10 BTC trades."

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

tools.name: get_funding
tools.title: Funding
tools.description: The funding rate, interval and next settlement for one market, and optionally its past settlements. Ask: "What has ETH funding been over the last day?"

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

history.description: also return this many past settlements, 1-400

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Account
tools.description: One account at a glance: USDC balances, positions with entry, mark, unrealized PnL and liquidation price, and open orders. Ask: "Check my account 0x…"

address.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte account address (0x followed by 40 hex characters)

tools.name: get_fills
tools.title: Trade history
tools.description: An account's recent trades with price, size, fee and realized PnL, as the explorer records them. Ask: "What did 0x… trade today?"

address.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte account address (0x followed by 40 hex characters)

tools.name: get_balance
tools.title: Balance
tools.description: An account's USDC: available to trade, in positions, reserved by orders, unrealized PnL. Ask: "How much USDC does 0x… have?"

address.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte account address (0x followed by 40 hex characters)

tools.name: get_positions
tools.title: Positions
tools.description: An account's open positions as the chain stores them. Ask: "What positions does 0x… hold?"

address.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte account address (0x followed by 40 hex characters)

tools.name: get_orders
tools.title: Open orders
tools.description: An account's resting orders, with their order ids. Ask: "Which orders does 0x… have open?"

address.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte account address (0x followed by 40 hex characters)

tools.name: get_agents
tools.title: Agents
tools.description: An owner's AI agents: status, limits and policy, usage, and each agent's latest actions. Ask: "What are my agents doing?"

tools.name: get_policy
tools.title: Agent policy
tools.description: Each agent's policy and market limits as the chain stores them, and whether the network enforces them now. Ask: "What limits does my agent trade under?"

tools.name: get_risk
tools.title: Agent usage
tools.description: Each agent's usage against its policy, as the chain accounts it. Ask: "How much of its daily loss limit has my agent used?"

tools.name: get_tiers
tools.title: Tiers
tools.description: Agent limits by tier and the referral tier table, where the network serves them. Ask: "How many agents can each tier run?"

tools.name: get_season
tools.title: Rewards season
tools.description: The current rewards season: status, VORD budget, rules, participants and how many qualify. Ask: "What is the current season?"

season_id.description: a season number (default: the current season)

tools.name: get_points
tools.title: Points
tools.description: An address's season points by source, its rank, whether it qualifies and its VORD estimate. Ask: "What's my rank in the season?"

address.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte account address (0x followed by 40 hex characters)

season_id.description: a season number (default: the current season)

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.title: Leaderboard
tools.description: The season's points leaderboard, or the trading leaderboard by PnL, ROI or volume. Ask: "Who leads the season?"

season_id.description: a season number (default: the current season)

tools.name: get_referrals
tools.title: Referrals
tools.description: An address's referral code, tier, referred volume and earnings. Ask: "How much have my referrals earned?"

address.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte account address (0x followed by 40 hex characters)

tools.name: get_tx
tools.title: Transaction
tools.description: One EVM transaction by hash: block, sender, receiver, value and result, with its explorer link. The hash is sent to the explorer to look it up, so give only a transaction hash, never a key. Ask: "Explain transaction 0x…"

tools.name: get_block
tools.title: Block
tools.description: One block by height: time, proposer, operations, with its explorer link. Ask: "What happened in block 152,000,000?"

tools.name: get_address
tools.title: Address
tools.description: An address summary: account value, open positions, agents and EVM transactions, with its explorer link. Ask: "Look up 0x…"

address.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte account address (0x followed by 40 hex characters)

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: One order
tools.description: One resting order by its id: market, side, price, size left. An order that is not resting now (it filled or was cancelled) is reported as gone. Ask: "What is the state of order 8840974?"

order_id.description: the chain's order id, as get_orders lists it

address.description: the account (default: the server's configured owner)

tools.name: check_order
tools.title: Check an order
tools.description: Check an order against every rule the network runs (market, size, price band, margin, the agent's limits) for the configured owner and agent, without signing or sending anything: whether it would be taken, each rule it breaks with the real numbers, and fixes that pass. Ask: "Can I buy 0.1 ETH at 20x?"

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

side.description: buy opens or adds to a long, sell to a short

size.description: in the market's base asset, e.g. 0.01 for 0.01 ETH

order_type.description: limit (default) rests at its price; market fills now

price.description: limit price in USD (limit orders only)

leverage.description: default: the highest the limits allow

reduce_only.description: only reduce an open position, never open or add

post_only.description: rest on the book or be refused; never take liquidity

tools.name: my_buying_power
tools.title: My buying power
tools.description: Per market, the largest long and short the configured owner can open at each allowed leverage, from free margin and the agent's limits together. Ask: "How much ETH can I buy?"

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

tools.name: place_order
tools.title: Place order
tools.description: Place a market or limit order as the configured agent, after checking it against every network rule (an order the network would refuse is not signed). Signed on this machine with the agent key (OS keychain or key file); the chain enforces the agent's policy and limits. Refused before anything is signed while the network reports agent trading off, or after stop_all. Every order is first confirmed by you in your AI app, unless you started the server with --orders auto.

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

side.description: buy opens or adds to a long, sell to a short

size.description: in the market's base asset, e.g. 0.01 for 0.01 ETH

order_type.description: limit (default) rests at its price; market fills now

price.description: limit price in USD (limit orders only)

reduce_only.description: only reduce an open position, never open or add

post_only.description: rest on the book or be refused; never take liquidity

tools.name: close_position
tools.title: Close position
tools.description: Close the owner's position in one market — all of it, or a fraction — with a reduce-only order (market by default), with the full pre-trade check. Signed on this machine with the agent key (OS keychain or key file); the chain enforces the agent's policy and limits. Refused before anything is signed while the network reports agent trading off, or after stop_all. Every order is first confirmed by you in your AI app, unless you started the server with --orders auto.

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

fraction.description: how much of the position, above 0 and at most 1 (default 1: all)

tools.name: set_tpsl
tools.title: Set take-profit / stop-loss
tools.description: Set, move or remove the take-profit and stop-loss of the owner's position in one market. A leg you do not name stays as it is; remove takes a leg off. A take-profit sits on the profit side of the mark, a stop-loss on the loss side. Signed on this machine with the agent key (OS keychain or key file); the chain enforces the agent's policy and limits. Refused before anything is signed while the network reports agent trading off, or after stop_all. Every order is first confirmed by you in your AI app, unless you started the server with --orders auto.

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

tools.name: modify_order
tools.title: Modify order
tools.description: Move one resting order to a new price and/or size: a signed cancel-and-replace (the new order gets a new id and no time priority); the new order is checked against the network's rules (its margin is the chain's to judge). Signed on this machine with the agent key (OS keychain or key file); the chain enforces the agent's policy and limits. Refused before anything is signed while the network reports agent trading off, or after stop_all. Every order is first confirmed by you in your AI app, unless you started the server with --orders auto.

order_id.description: the chain's order id, as get_orders lists it

price.description: new limit price in USD (default: unchanged)

size.description: new size in the base asset (default: what is left)

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel order
tools.description: Cancel one of the configured owner's resting orders, as the agent. Signed on this machine with the agent key (OS keychain or key file); the chain enforces the agent's policy and limits. Refused before anything is signed while the network reports agent trading off, or after stop_all.

order_id.description: the chain's order id, as get_orders lists it

tools.name: cancel_all
tools.title: Cancel all orders
tools.description: Cancel every resting order of the configured owner — in one market, or in all of them — as the agent. Signed on this machine with the agent key (OS keychain or key file); the chain enforces the agent's policy and limits. Refused before anything is signed while the network reports agent trading off, or after stop_all.

symbol.description: market symbol as get_markets lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH or ETHUSDT

pair_id.description: or the market's pair id, e.g. 1

tools.name: stop_all
tools.title: Stop all (kill switch)
tools.description: Stop this server from signing anything new (only cancels, until you run `vordium-mcp resume` on this machine), then cancel every resting order. Revoking the agent itself on the chain is the owner's step in Vordex → Agents.
